# LayerKind

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public enum LayerKind
```

How a layer's rolled variant image is turned into pixels.

## Values

- <span id="f-static"></span>`Static = 0` - A grayscale value-map colorized with EXACTLY ONE fixed color, deterministically. Consumes no RNG, so a static layer adds no cross-asset uniqueness.
- <span id="f-dynamic"></span>`Dynamic = 1` - A grayscale value-map whose hue and saturation are ROLLED per asset from the layer's colorization. This is what makes the output space larger than the source art.
- <span id="f-custom"></span>`Custom = 2` - A full-color RGBA image composited AS-IS and never colorized. Its colorization must be null.
